name: Circle of Life

features.name: Tree of Life
features.description: Winning trees stick and grow up a row each respin.

features.name: Respin chains
features.description: Keep going while the tree keeps winning.

review:
Circle of Life is a nature-themed slot with Tree symbols that act as wilds and reveal additive multipliers from 2x to 100x. When a tree joins a win, a respin is triggered. The tree sticks and grows upward by one row into a Tree of Life, while everything else respins.

The sequence continues as long as the growing tree keeps forming wins, so a tree can climb to the top of the reel and add more to each new win. Several trees in one win add their values together. The cap is 15,000x, and the art is gentle and warm.
